youtube_title: The Office No Shave November Contest Went Terribly Wrong
description:
Denise has called a meeting about the office No Shave November contest. There are slides. There is a very suspicious mustache, a very sudden beard, and a very upset razor.

#cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #office
tiktok_caption: our office no shave november contest needed a formal update. i'm so sorry. #cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #office

lines.text: Thank you for coming. This is a formal update on No Shave November.
Slide one. A fun office contest. Everybody smiling. I'm so sorry.
Why are you sorry? That slide looks great.
Rob. We will get to you.
Allow me to introduce myself. I am Gerald. I am the razor in Hank's desk drawer.
As of this contest, I am unemployed.
It's one month, buddy.
You said that about the gym.
Slide two. Rob's progress photo.
Thank you. I have worked very hard on this mustache.
Rob, that mustache is very dark and very even.
It's called genetics.
It is also on your shirt.
Those are also genetics.
It says permanent marker on his hand.
That's my doctor's name. Doctor Permanent Marker.
I'm so sorry.
Slide three. Hank.
Yep. That's me. Just a natural man, growing naturally.
Hank, on Friday you had no beard. Today I cannot see your tie.
Strong follicles. Runs in the family.
Yesterday, the printer jammed. We found the problem.
It was in the beard. The stapler was also in the beard.
That stapler came to me.
Hank, how is yours so long already? I have been drawing for two days.
Eat protein, Rob. And stop asking questions.
Slide four. The grievance.
I have filed a formal complaint. Item one, emotional abandonment.
He has also formed a support group.
It meets in the drawer. There is me, a nail clipper, and some floss.
Floss is there? How is the floss doing?
Nobody has seen the floss used in years, Rob. It's used to it.
I'm so sorry. Slide five. Yes, the prize.
The winner receives one small gift card for the sandwich place.
And it's mine. I'm basically a tree.
We have not even judged it yet.
Denise, may I show them the last slide?
The last slide is why I booked this room.
This is a photo from the office Halloween party. Friday night.
Hey, that's Hank. Dressed as a lumberjack.
And what, pray tell, is on the lumberjack's face?
That could be anybody's beard.
Hank, it has a price tag on it. Nineteen dollars. It is on your ear right now.
You glued on a beard? For a sandwich?
You drew yours on with a marker, Rob.
It won't come off, by the way. I tried. It's a very good glue.
Mine won't come off either. I have tried soap. And a lawyer.
Gentlemen. At last. Somebody needs me.
Sit down, Gerald. Contest rules. Nobody shaves until the month is over.
But surely it is nearly over. All of this has been an absolute eternity.
Right. We have got to be near the end. What's today?
Today is November second.
Second of what?
There are twenty eight days left, Hank.
Rob, Hank, thank you all for coming. That was my presentation.
I'll be in the drawer. Tell the floss I'm so sorry.
